title: A Parish for the Alibi Revisited
author: Petra Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Pemberton, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
